:::{#def-existential-quantifier}
#### Existential quantifier

The **existential quantifier**
[@wikipedia_existential_quantification]
"there exists" is a quantifier (@def-quantifier):
$\exists x \in S, P(x)$ ("there is an $x$ in $S$ such that $P(x)$")
is true when $P(x)$ is true for at least one element $x$ of $S$,
and false otherwise.

:::
